description: Use for inflation in EU countries, the place of Poland in the EU and price growth since a year. For the CPI of Statistics Poland, use get_macro_indicator. Harmonised inflation (HICP, annual rate) in the 27 EU countries, the EU and the euro area from Eurostat, monthly since 2000: the latest month with Poland, ranking from the highest inflation, change vs the previous month, the place of Poland and the place a month and a year earlier, five components (core inflation, food, energy, services, industrial goods), price growth in every country since the same month of a chosen year (basket), the finwire index finwire_eu_inflation_gap (Polish HICP minus EU HICP, percentage points) and the euro area flash estimate when newer. With country: that country's monthly component history. HICP is the EU-comparable measure; for the national CPI of Statistics Poland use get_macro_indicator.

compare.description: EU country code added to the history next to Poland, default DE.

country.description: EU country code (Eurostat, Greece = EL) for its component history and place; default Poland.

since.description: Start year of the basket (price growth since the same month of that year), default 2015.

name: get_eu_inflation
title: Inflation in EU countries (Eurostat HICP)
